products.title: High Visibility Mr. EGGhead Custom Inflatable
products.body_html:
Mr. EGGhead® is a 5-foot (1.5 m) inflatable character designed to enhance Big Green Egg gatherings and outdoor cooking events. This compact character transforms outdoor cooking events into memorable celebrations, creating an irresistible backdrop for photos and conversations. With its internally-mounted blower, Mr. EGGhead® inflates quietly, maintaining a festive atmosphere without disruption. Versatile and eye-catching, it's equally at home at backyard barbecues, tailgate parties, or retail displays.

  • Dimensions: 5 feet (1.5 m) tall
  • Power: Standard 120V household current (US)
  • Features: Internal blower for quiet operation
  • Suitable for indoor and outdoor use (excluding rain or high wind conditions)

Care: Gently clean with mild detergent and air dry. Store away from direct sunlight when not in use to preserve vibrant colors. Adult supervision required; not intended as a toy.
